repair: Let B be the proper nonempty face poset of a tetrahedron. Twist composition in its central C2-extension E_c by the normalized 2-cocycle supported on one maximal chain. A disk presentation kills its central generator, so E_c is simply connected. Put Y=int_[1](e→B), r:Y→B, and X=Y×_B E_c. The first projection p:X→Y has fibre BC2 and identity transports, so is a HOT-fibration. Every base change of q:Y→[1] induces a fundamental-groupoid equivalence, by its section and unique fibre paths. Both factors satisfy all p122 contractible-base tests. But X≃E_c is simply connected while X_0=BC2, so the composite fails the test e_0→[1]: restriction Set→C2-Set has only trivial actions in its essential image.
references: Cisinski2009LocallyConstant, Theorem 3.13 (comparison of scope; not a source for this construction).
notes: Complete proof in development The 2-complete variant also fails to compose, marked ours without a priority claim. E_c has 14 objects and 100 morphisms; Y has 15 objects and 58 morphisms; X has 15 objects and 116 morphisms. The finite categories have automorphisms and are not posets. Counterexample valid for Dia=Cat; no unannounced claim for the finite-poset domain.
